functions.name: run_strategic_scan
functions.title: Run Strategic Analytics Skip-Trace
functions.description: Searches all connected analytics accounts (Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Sheets, Supabase), auto-detects businesses, fetches metrics from every connected data source, finds performance gaps, and returns AI-generated recommendations on how to close each gap. Call when the user asks for a gap analysis, performance audit, or strategic scan of their businesses.

business_id.description: Optional. Limit the scan to a single business by its ID. Omit to scan all businesses.

force_refresh.description: If true, re-fetches fresh data even if a recent snapshot exists. Defaults to false.

functions.name: list_data_sources
functions.title: List Connected Data Sources
functions.description: Returns all connected data sources (Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Supabase, Meta Ads, TikTok) and vault-stored API keys so the AI can see what data is available. Call when the user asks what data sources are connected or what data the AI can see.
